name: Salt & Sea Scuba
summary: A small PADI dive shop at Mango Bay Hotel, steps from Holetown Beach, run by owner and PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer Karina. They take no more than five divers at a time on their boat Thalassa, and also run snorkel trips, private charters and kids' holiday camps. Trip times are set around each booking.
standouts: Describes itself as the first female-owned dive shop on the island
No more than five divers per session
Owner is a PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer
Based at Mango Bay Hotel on Holetown Beach

contact.address: Mango Bay Hotel, Holetown, Saint James, Barbados

trips.title: Dives & Dive Packages
trips.summary: Guided boat dives off the west coast for certified divers, sold as a single dive or packages of two to ten. Groups are kept to five divers, each led by a dive professional with a computer.
highlights: No more than 5 divers at a time
Every dive led by a dive professional with a computer

prices.label: Dive computer rental
prices.note: Per day, first come first served

trips.requirements: Certified divers only; proof of certification required. PADI diver medical form for all divers, with a doctor's clearance if you answer yes to any condition.
trips.checkNotes: Book by email or WhatsApp; payment on arrival. Excursion times are set per booking. Dive computer rental is from the FAQ page.

trips.title: Night Dive
trips.summary: A guided night dive for certified divers. It needs at least four divers and is booked separately from the dive packages.
trips.requirements: Certified divers only; minimum of 4 divers

trips.title: Discover Scuba Dive
trips.summary: A first try at scuba for beginners. You learn the basics and practise in shallow water, then take a short boat ride to dive among sunken shipwrecks and reef fish. It is not a certification, but it can count toward Open Water.
highlights: One open water dive on shipwrecks
Can count toward PADI Open Water

trips.title: Bubblemaker
trips.summary: A first scuba experience for children aged 8 and up, with a PADI professional. Kids breathe underwater and explore shallow water no deeper than 2 metres.
highlights: One dive to a maximum of 2 metres / 6 feet

trips.title: Open Water Diver
trips.summary: The first PADI certification, taught by a PADI instructor over about three days. The theory is done by eLearning, then confined water training and four open water dives. You finish certified to dive to 18 metres.

trips.title: Open Water Referral
trips.summary: For students who have done their theory and pool training with another PADI dive centre at home. You finish the four open water training dives over two days in Barbados.
highlights: Theory and pool work done with a PADI centre at home within the past 12 months
trips.requirements: Minimum age 10; dive theory and confined water training completed with another PADI dive center within the past 12 months
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $ ($400.00). Every other price on the page is marked USD.

trips.title: Advanced Open Water Diver
trips.summary: Five dives that build on Open Water: navigation, a deep dive and three specialty dives you choose. It runs over two to three days.
highlights: Navigation and deep dive, plus three of your choice

trips.title: Rescue Diver
trips.summary: Rescue exercises and scenarios that teach you to spot and handle problems before they grow, and to help other divers. Two days in the water plus a day of Emergency First Response, which you can skip if you already hold a valid PADI-approved CPR and first aid card.
highlights: Lower price if you already hold EFR or equivalent

prices.label: Inclusive of Emergency First Response (EFR) certification

trips.title: Emergency First Response
trips.summary: A one-day first aid and CPR course for lay rescuers, on its own or as part of Rescue Diver.

trips.title: ReActivate
trips.summary: A refresher for certified divers who have not dived for more than two years. It combines eLearning, a confined water lesson and one open water dive.
highlights: For divers out of the water for 2 years or more

trips.title: PADI Specialty Courses
trips.summary: PADI specialties for certified divers: Deep, Wreck, Night, Drift, Boat, Peak Performance Buoyancy and Dive Against Debris. Each includes eLearning materials, equipment rental and its open water dives.
highlights: Deep Diver and Wreck Diver: 2 days, 4 dives
Dive Against Debris: remove and record marine debris

prices.label: Deep Diver
prices.note: Min. age 15; prerequisite Adventure Diver; 2 days; 4 open water dives

prices.label: Wreck Diver
prices.note: Min. age 15; prerequisite Adventure Diver; 2 days; 4 open water dives

prices.label: Night Diver
prices.note: Min. age 12; prerequisite Open Water Diver; 2 to 3 evenings; 3 open water dives

prices.label: Drift Diver
prices.note: Min. age 12; prerequisite Open Water Diver; 1 day; 2 open water dives

prices.label: Boat Diver
prices.note: Min. age 10; prerequisite Open Water Diver; 1 day; 2 open water dives

prices.label: Peak Performance Buoyancy
prices.note: Min. age 10; prerequisite Open Water Diver; half day; 2 open water dives

prices.label: Dive Against Debris
prices.note: Min. age 10; prerequisite Open Water Diver; 1 day; 1 open water dive

includes: Open water dives for the course
trips.requirements: Open Water Diver or Adventure Diver, depending on the course
trips.checkNotes: Grouped under the page's PADI Specialty Courses heading; each course has its own price, age and prerequisite in the notes.

trips.title: 1 Hour Snorkel
trips.summary: An easy one-hour snorkel in calm west coast water. You snorkel the shallow sunken wrecks near Folkestone, then stop again to swim where turtles, rays and tarpons are often seen.
highlights: Second stop with turtles, rays and tarpons
trips.checkNotes: The site notes that wildlife sightings are not guaranteed and sites depend on the weather.

trips.title: Cruise & Snorkel
trips.summary: A longer trip that mixes snorkelling with time cruising the coast. You can snorkel the Folkestone wrecks and swim with turtles and rays, then cruise north up the west coast, or head south to Carlisle Bay and its six shipwrecks.
highlights: Choice of Folkestone and a west coast cruise, or Carlisle Bay
Optional dive, Discover Scuba, graze boxes or alcohol
trips.checkNotes: Snorkel site and cruise direction depend on the weather on the day. The page does not say whether the price is per person.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Your own trip on the boat Thalassa along the west coast, with snorkel and beach stops and light snacks included. You can add a certified dive or Discover Scuba, alcohol, or charcuterie graze boxes ordered 48 hours ahead.
highlights: Add a dive or Discover Scuba
trips.checkNotes: The charter price is per hour for the boat, not per person. Graze boxes are made by Mezza Barbados (FAQ page).

trips.title: Holiday Camps
trips.summary: Week-long holiday day camps for children aged 8 to 14, run from Mango Bay Hotel. Activities include snorkelling, an introduction to scuba and freediving, STEM activities, ocean conservation and a Friday beach picnic.
highlights: Ages 8 to 14, must be able to swim
Snorkeling, intro to scuba and intro to freediving
Snacks and water provided; picnic lunch on Fridays

prices.label: Per child, per week
prices.note: Sibling discount for siblings enrolled in the same week

includes: Snacks and water through the day
bring: Packed lunch or lunch money (except Fridays)
trips.requirements: Ages 8 to 14; kids must be able to swim; a parent or guardian must come on the first day to pay in full and sign up

offer.conditions: For siblings enrolled in the same week

trips.checkNotes: The Dates section on the page is empty, so no camp dates are known. Payment by cash, cheque or bank transfer, in full on the first day, non-refundable. The page states the sibling discount as a percentage; left out here. Aimed at local families more than visitors.

checkNotes: Enquiry only: the site asks guests to book by email or WhatsApp (no wa.me link shown, so the WhatsApp number is not confirmed; the listed phone is +1 246 844 2244). Payment on arrival, cash (US or Barbados currency) or card. Cancellations within 72 hours are non-refundable. Opening hours: Monday closed, Tuesday 10 am to 4 pm, Wednesday to Saturday 9 am to 3 pm, Sunday by appointment; closed 18 September to 3 October for maintenance and on some holidays. Excursion times are set per booking, so no fixed departure times. The home page hero and most course images are GoDaddy stock photos, so the hero here is the operator's own boat photo.
